title: Fox News ownership and voting control
summary: Fox News is a United States news channel and digital news service operated by Fox News Network, LLC, a subsidiary of Fox Corporation. LGC Holdco held 38.76% of Fox Corporation’s Class B shares in its August 2026 ownership table. Lachlan Murdoch controls voting of that block through appointment rights. These are unreviewed public-source findings.

gaps: The graph stops after three relationship levels. LGC’s family trusts and Cruden 2 are described but not expanded into additional upstream nodes.
The subsidiary exhibit establishes Fox Corporation as a parent but does not establish the immediate legal holding chain or a precise equity percentage.

Institutional holdings in the August 2026 table rely on filings with different observation dates: State Street Class A June 30, 2026 and Class B September 30, 2025; BlackRock Class A March 31, 2025 and Class B March 31, 2026.
The September 2025 family settlement replaced the older Murdoch Family Trust arrangement. Its initially projected 36.2% Class B holding is superseded here by the later 38.76% table.

Recent transaction searches found Fox’s proposed Roku acquisition. The opened September 1, 2026 prospectus schedules shareholder votes for October 14, 2026; prospective post-merger ownership is excluded.
No completed sale of Fox News was identified in the sources reviewed. Current holdings after the latest disclosed observation dates remain unverified.
